verdict: v14 rebuilt from RT-14 (routing draft, 12 unconnected, DRC 0) with the v13 pipeline and the 2-cell (1S2P) enclosure unchanged: 0 unintended overlaps (164 solids, 89 intended), woofer chamber net 0.525 L, main 1.962 L, lid cutouts aligned, three print bodies valid without supports. The four v13 footprint errors are fixed on RT-14. SW100 actuator now ends at the board edge: 0.50 mm behind the lid inner face, 4.50 mm behind the outer face, so a lid plunger is still needed. Woofer screw engagement stays marginal (M3x20).

findings.title: SW100: actuator at the board edge, still 4.50 mm behind the lid outer face (lid plunger needed)
findings.detail: RT-14 redrawn TE 1977066-1 footprint moved the switch 2.295 mm toward the rear edge (y 25.245 -> 22.95). Measured in CAD: actuator (dia 2.0, axis 1.70 above the board top, X -14.68 Z 70.30) tip at Y 202.10 = board rear edge (0.00 mm past it), 0.50 mm short of the lid inner face (Y 202.6) and 4.50 mm behind the lid outer face (Y 206.6). v13 (draft footprint): 2.80 / 6.80 mm. The 5.0 bore is centred on the actuator axis (radial 1.5); the nearest switch geometry is 1.35 mm from the lid. A fingertip cannot reach it: a printed plunger must bridge 4.50 mm (lid 4.0 + 0.5 gap) plus its own protrusion and travel. Only 0.5 mm is free behind the lid, so a retaining collar would need a counterbore in the lid inner face (owner decision; not modelled, v14 keeps the v13 lid). Switch travel not extracted (TE PDF is a drawing without text).

findings.title: TP20 moved 40.8 mm (RT-14) clears every enclosure body
findings.detail: TP20 (Keystone 5015, 1.5 above the board) from (110.155, 149.645) to (123.9, 111.25): nearest body the H4 PCB spacer 8.54 mm (its M3x16 head 8.77), 11.6 mm to the insert roof under the board, 11.99 mm to the shell; woofer harness tube 70.6 mm (J5 harness farther); 26.9 mm under the top wall. In v13 it was 22.9 mm from the shell.

findings.title: All 42 references changed since RT-3 (v13 board) clear the enclosure
findings.detail: Exact distance to every enclosure body (no bounding-box prefilter). Tightest moved parts: TP2 2.55 mm to the H3 M3x16 head (v13 3.52), TP14 3.06 / TP12 3.15 to the H2 head (swapped places, v13 3.15 / 3.06), SW100 1.35 to the lid, R113 4.74 to the lid, C106 5.53 to the H3 head. R225 (5.79 mm move) and R142 (2.42) are 11.6 mm above the woofer-chamber insert roof (12.05 / 13.8 to the next body). C230-C240, R220-R238, U8, U9 (jack/headphone switch block re-placed, 2.2-10 mm moves) all 11.6 mm to the insert roof and >= 17.9 mm to screws/woofer. Full list in moved_parts.

In CAD the two 0.448 mm3 peg/board collisions per jack are gone (J2/J3 vs board 3.72 -> 2.82 mm3; the remaining 2.82 is the jack nose below the board top at the rear edge, intended class as v13). Lid bores unchanged: radial 1.25, 1.51 mm from the lid.

findings.title: U1 BM83 pad 56 at +4.77
findings.detail: Pad-only change; the module model and its y -0.427 offset are unchanged, 6.05 mm from the shell.

findings.title: Woofer screws: M3x20 gives only 3.4-4.4 mm thread in the 5.7 mm insert (unchanged from v13)
findings.detail: Stack: head on the frame back (z 19.60) through the 13.3 frame block and the 3.3 gasket. M3x20 engages 3.4 mm with the gasket free, 4.4 mm with 1 mm compression (1.1-1.5 d; tip 2.3 mm above the pilot floor). Raising the seat to fit longer screws pushes the magnet into the roof (3.25 mm left). Options: accept M3x20 (gasket compresses), or M3x22 (DIN 912; 5.4-6.4 mm, still inside the 6.7 pilot) if the owner can source it. Frame thickness and gasket are photo estimates (+-1.5): measure before printing.

findings.title: fit.json 'nearest' is prefiltered
findings.detail: fit_check.py lists only bodies whose box lies within 6 mm, so for parts far from everything it reports the shell (27.9 mm) although the insert roof under the board is 11.6 mm away. The moved-part distances above are exact (scratch script, all bodies). Two distance artefacts guarded: C244, R223 vs the woofer harness (true about 40 mm).
